nodes.label: Saifymatteo Monorepo
nodes.rationale: Three independent projects live under a GitHub profile README root; the root directory is the GitHub profile README and code must never be edited there.

nodes.label: nextjs Project
nodes.rationale: New portfolio, work in progress; stack is Next.js 16 (App Router), Node 22, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui (base-luma style), TypeScript.

nodes.label: flutter_web Project
nodes.rationale: Published portfolio site; Flutter web (SDK 3.35.7 via puro), Dart 3.9, Provider, auto_route, deployed to Cloudflare Workers. Entry lib/main.dart calls usePathUrlStrategy(); MyApp uses MultiProvider + MaterialApp.router with two routes (/ and /portfolio/:title).

nodes.label: plain_html Project
nodes.rationale: Legacy Bootstrap 4 + jQuery static site, no longer active; kept only for reference.

nodes.label: deploy.ps1 Deployment Script
nodes.rationale: Bumps version, builds release, deploys flutter_web to Cloudflare via wrangler, then tags and pushes.

nodes.label: Prefer Relative Imports Convention
nodes.rationale: Flutter imports must use ../../foo.dart rather than package:flutter_web/foo.dart to avoid package-name coupling; mirrors prefer_relative_imports: true in analysis_options.yaml.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits Convention
nodes.rationale: Commits are scoped [flutter_web], [nextjs], or [root] so changes can be attributed to the right project inside the monorepo.

nodes.label: OpenSpec
nodes.rationale: Configured in openspec/config.yaml with spec-driven schema; context notes the three-project monorepo; proposals under 1500 words, tasks chunked to <=2 hours.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Knowledge graph at graphify-out/ with god nodes, community structure, and cross-file relationships; query/path/explain commands return a scoped subgraph, and graphify update . is run after code changes (AST-only).

nodes.label: Generated Files (do not edit)
nodes.rationale: route.gr.dart (auto_route), app_localizations_en.dart (flutter localizations from arb), assets.gen.dart (flutter_gen) and nextjs/.next are generated output and must not be hand-edited.

nodes.label: Saiful Mashuri
nodes.rationale: Senior Software Engineer from Malaysia specializing in Flutter/Dart cross-platform development and GraphQL-based front-end architecture; 7x GraphQL payload reduction, 30%+ efficiency gains, Harvard CS50x graduate (2021); contact work@saifulmashuri.com.

nodes.label: MKR Unofficial App (Flutter)
nodes.rationale: Published app on Google Play (com.saifymatteo.mkr_flutter), built in Flutter.

nodes.label: Parking Lot Game (Flutter)
nodes.rationale: Published game on Google Play (com.saifymatteo.parking_lot_game), built in Flutter.

nodes.label: Simple App State Management
nodes.rationale: Project follows the Flutter simple app state management tutorial as its starting point.

nodes.label: Flutter Localization
nodes.rationale: Localized messages are generated from arb files found in lib/localization; internationalization follows the Flutter tutorial.

nodes.label: Flutter Online Documentation
nodes.rationale: Cited as the source for tutorials, samples, guidance on mobile development, and the full API reference.

nodes.label: flutter_web Analysis Options
nodes.rationale: Includes package:flutter_lints/flutter.yaml and enforces prefer_relative_imports: true with always_use_package_imports: false.

nodes.label: Launch Screen Assets
nodes.rationale: Launch screen is customized by replacing image files in the imageset or via the Xcode project at ios/Runner.xcworkspace.

nodes.label: Flutter l10n Configuration
nodes.rationale: arb-dir lib/localization, template app_en.arb, output class AppLocalizations, nullable-getter false, format true.

nodes.label: Linux Runner CMake Build
nodes.rationale: Builds BINARY_NAME flutter_web with APPLICATION_ID com.example.flutter_web, links GTK, and bundles flutter_assets plus AOT library into a relocatable bundle.

nodes.label: Linux Flutter Library CMake
nodes.rationale: Flutter-tool-managed file that defines the flutter interface library against libflutter_linux_gtk.so, GTK/GLIB/GIO, and the flutter_assemble target.

nodes.label: Windows Runner CMake Build
nodes.rationale: Project-level Windows config; instead of a separate bundle (as on Linux) support files are copied next to the executable so building/running from Visual Studio works.

nodes.label: Windows Flutter Library CMake
nodes.rationale: Defines the flutter interface library against flutter_windows.dll plus flutter_wrapper_plugin/flutter_wrapper_app static wrappers and the flutter_assemble target.

nodes.label: Windows Runner App Target CMake
nodes.rationale: Defines the WIN32 executable target (flutter_window.cpp, main.cpp, utils.cpp, win32_window.cpp) linked against flutter and flutter_wrapper_app with FLUTTER_VERSION defines.

nodes.label: flutter_web pubspec.yaml
nodes.rationale: version 1.1.0+4, publish_to none, Dart >=3.9.0, Flutter >=3.35.0; generate: true enables localization generation from arb files; assets include icons, images, and portfolio images; flutter_gen outputs class AppAssets to lib/constants.

nodes.label: auto_route
nodes.rationale: Dependency ^10.1.2 with auto_route_generator ^10.2.4; generates route.gr.dart via build_runner.

nodes.label: Provider
nodes.rationale: State management dependency ^6.1.5+1 used by MyApp's MultiProvider.

nodes.label: build_runner
nodes.rationale: Codegen driver ^2.7.1 run as: dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs.

nodes.label: flutter_gen
nodes.rationale: flutter_gen_runner ^5.12.0 generates AppAssets class into lib/constants for bundled assets.

nodes.label: flutter_web Web Index (index.html)
nodes.rationale: Serves the Saiful Mashuri portfolio; base href is a $FLUTTER_BASE_HREF placeholder replaced by --base-href; includes preloader, manifest, iOS meta tags, and Google Analytics tag G-2HQ4SXE1CJ.

nodes.label: Google Analytics (gtag.js)
nodes.rationale: Measurement ID G-2HQ4SXE1CJ loaded via googletagmanager.

nodes.label: Next.js Project (create-next-app)
nodes.rationale: Standard create-next-app bootstrap; dev server, next/font for font optimization, deployable on Vercel.

nodes.label: next/font
nodes.rationale: Automatically optimizes and loads the Geist font family for Vercel.

nodes.label: Vercel
nodes.rationale: The recommended deployment platform for Next.js apps created with create-next-app.
